notes: THE "iPhone Duo" DETERMINATION: Apple HAS announced a foldable iPhone, and the requester's name is Apple's OFFICIAL name - no alias translation needed. Announced 2026-09-09 (newsroom), pre-orders 2026-10-16 at 5 a.m. PT, on sale 2026-10-23. `released` holds the FIRST-WAVE date only: Apple states availability begins 2026-10-23 in the launch countries and 2026-10-30 in "28 other countries and regions". NOTE: this is a FUTURE date - as of the 2026-09-13 snapshot the device is announced and fully specced but NOT yet shipping, so every number here is Apple's published pre-release specification, not a measured retail unit. All figures below were re-verified against the raw HTML of apple.com/iphone-duo/specs/ by curl, not only via the fetch-and-summarize layer. AXIS WARNING for CAD: Apple labels the LONG axis of this product "Width", not "Height" - open is 164.6mm wide x 117.8mm tall, closed is 84.1mm wide x 117.8mm tall, so the 117.8mm dimension is common to both states and the hinge runs along it. Mapped literally from Apple's own labels; do not swap. Both states share one mass (254 g). corner_radius is null, and this was checked two ways: (1) developer.apple.com/accessories/dimensional-drawings/ lists iPhone 12 through iPhone 17 Pro Max plus iPhone Air and iPhone 16e/17e but has NO iPhone Duo entry as of 2026-09-13; (2) the full "Accessory Design Guidelines for Apple Devices" PDF (Release R30, downloaded 2026-09-13, 39 MB) contains ZERO occurrences of the string "Duo" - its newest hardware is iPhone 17 / 17e / 17 Pro / 17 Pro Max / iPhone Air. So no Apple dimensioned drawing exists yet for this device and no radius can be cited. Re-check the drawings index after the 2026-10-23 ship date; that is the source that will eventually carry radii and port-cutout geometry for CAD. depth_at_hinge null: Apple publishes a single closed depth. DERIVED: active_area_mm = (px / ppi) x 25.4 for each axis, using only Apple-sourced resolution and ppi. Inner 1878/430x25.4 = 110.93mm by 2670/430x25.4 = 157.72mm; cover 1398/460x25.4 = 77.19mm by 2034/460x25.4 = 112.31mm. Cross-check: those give diagonals of 7.591in and 5.365in, matching Apple's own statement that the screens are "7.58 and 5.36 inches diagonally" when measured as a standard rectangle - so the derivation is validated against a second Apple figure. aspect strings are the reduced integer ratio of the sourced resolution. hinge.axis=long is read directly off Apple's own dimension pair - 117.8mm is common to the open and closed states, so the fold necessarily runs along that edge - rather than from an Apple statement naming the axis. hinge.max_angle_deg/free_stop/crease null: Apple describes "a precision hinge" and "an integrated magnet array" but publishes no angle, free-stop or crease-geometry figure. Apple also states the inner display has a "nano-textured cover layer made from a custom polymer" with "high-strength glass above and below the folding display panel" - materials.cover_glass records the outer Ceramic Shield 2 only. Device is eSIM-only (no physical SIM slot), so no sim port entry.
